title: Filming: Hi, Hi, Hi, C Moon by Wings | 1972
content:
Wings filmed promotional clips for ‘Hi, Hi, Hi’ and ‘C Moon’ on 14 November 1972.

The shoot took place at Television Centre in Southampton, where they had filmed promos for ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’ on 13 May.

The clips were shot on 2″ quadruplex videotape, and were directed by Steve Turner, who had worked on the BBC music series Colour Me Pop.

I had turned freelance, setting up my own Take One Productions company, when, out of the blue, I got a call saying that I’d been recommended, would I be interested in working with Paul. Paul’s a great ideas man and was wanting to change things as we went along, which I was happy to do because his suggestions always fitted in. The only problem was the studio was being refurbished so I had to sit in an outdoor outside-broadcast wagon rather than in the control room. Paul likes his directors to work with him on the floor, but I couldn’t because it took too long to go back and forth between the two places. Still, everyone was happy with the clips in the end.
Steve Turner
Club Sandwich Christmas 1991

The shoot was vision mixed at the time, so required no post-production, and at the end of the day the finished clips were given to Paul McCartney.
